item.title: Trump hits International Criminal Court with sanctions after Nobel goes to former judge
item.description: The sanctions are aimed at cutting the ICC off from the global financial system and include threats of punishment for countries that do business with the court.

item.title: Trump announces diesel deal with Russia in bid to lower prices
item.description: The amount is small compared with U.S. demand, but the deal aligns the U.S. with Russia and against Ukraine’s efforts to bomb Russian refineries.

item.title: Navi Pillay, leading human rights jurist, awarded Nobel Peace Prize
item.description: The trailblazing South African human rights lawyer and International Criminal Court judge was recognized for her work “ensuring that war crimes, crimes against humanity and genocide are prosecuted.”
